connector.name: QuickBooks Online MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: QuickBooks Online MCP server for invoices, customers, and payments. OAuth 2.1 + PKCE, stdio/HTTP.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package mcp-quickbooks. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the amin-ale account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.
